name: dsh-browser
description: Browser (package and row `dsh-browser`, kind/address `browser` / `sidebar://browser`): a BROWSER TAB for the vn-harness right bar (dsh-rightbar) - address bar, back / forward / reload / stop, a connection LED, Copy and Open - whose page is drawn by the browser already showing the GUI (one <iframe>), so the harness ships no engine and downloads nothing. A page type like the editor and History: one guide entry on the tab strip's + / Start page at order 40, no core patches, nothing forked. One host route, /api/dsh-browser/probe, asks an address whether it lets itself be framed (X-Frame-Options / CSP frame-ancestors) before anything loads, which is the one thing a cross-origin frame cannot answer for itself. Alpha.
